name: IRONMAN Florida
note: Entered by hand from the Panama City Beach Police Department traffic advisory graphic (site/photos/events/ironman-florida-2026-closures.jpg) and Visit Panama City Beach's race guide. Times are Central (CST, UTC-6; daylight time ends Nov 1). Map lines: data/events/place_closures.py.

closures.limits: Front Beach Rd to L C Hilton Jr Dr
West Park Dr to Powell Adams Rd
Front Beach Rd to Pier Park Dr
Pier Park Dr to Philip Griffitts Sr Pkwy

closure_source: Panama City Beach Police Department, IRONMAN road closures traffic advisory, Saturday, November 7, 2026
guide_source: Visit Panama City Beach, IRONMAN Florida

guide.title: South Pier Park Drive closes, 6 AM
guide.text: Front Beach Road to L C Hilton Jr Drive, while the finish area and IRONMAN Village go up. It reopens Sunday, November 8 at noon.

guide.title: IRONMAN Village opens at Aaron Bessant Park
guide.text: Free and open to everyone for several days before the race: athlete check-in, briefings, gear pickup and the official store.

guide.title: Practice swim at Russell-Fields Pier
guide.text: Athletes get one last swim in the Gulf before race morning.

guide.title: Front Beach Road and West Park Drive close
guide.text: Front Beach Road from West Park Drive to Powell Adams Road, and West Park Drive from Front Beach Road to Pier Park Drive.

guide.title: Swim start at Russell-Fields Pier
guide.text: Two loops around the pier, starting at sunrise (about 6 AM).

guide.title: Bike course delays begin
guide.text: Pier Park Drive to Philip Griffitts Sr Parkway until 11 AM, while athletes ride out.

guide.title: Runners on Front Beach Road
guide.text: Two loops along the beach and through neighborhoods. The leaders finish in the afternoon.

guide.title: Finish line closes
guide.text: The last hours at Pier Park are the loudest of the day. IRONMAN's standard time limit is 17 hours; the athlete guide has the exact cutoffs.

guide.title: Front Beach Road and West Park Drive reopen
guide.text: South Pier Park Drive follows at noon.

guide.title: Swim
guide.text: Two loops around Russell-Fields Pier in the Gulf, with a short run across the sand between loops.

guide.title: Bike
guide.text: One loop out of Pier Park along the Intracoastal Waterway and coastal back roads. Mostly flat, with some rolling stretches and wind that can build through the day.

guide.title: Run
guide.text: Two loops along the shoreline and through beach neighborhoods, finishing under the lights at Pier Park.

guide.title: Sunrise swim start
guide.text: The beach on both sides of Russell-Fields Pier. Get there before 6 AM.

guide.title: Transitions
guide.text: Transition areas give a close-up look as athletes change from swim to bike and bike to run.

guide.title: Front Beach Road
guide.text: The run is two loops, so you can see your athlete twice from the same spot.

guide.title: The finish at Pier Park
guide.text: Music and lights all evening, up to the midnight cutoff.

guide.title: IRONMAN Village
guide.text: Aaron Bessant Park, free and open to everyone during race week.

guide.title: South Pier Park Drive is closed all week
guide.text: From Nov 1 at 6 AM to noon Nov 8. Reach Pier Park from Panama City Beach Parkway or North Pier Park Drive.

guide.title: Front Beach Road on race day
guide.text: Closed from West Park Drive to Powell Adams Road, 2 AM Saturday to 4 AM Sunday. Use Panama City Beach Parkway (US 98) to get around it.

guide.title: Bike course delays
guide.text: From 6:30 to 11 AM Saturday, expect delays on Pier Park Drive up to Philip Griffitts Sr Parkway as cyclists ride out.

guide.title: Plan ahead
guide.text: Allow extra travel time and expect heavy event traffic near Pier Park. Park once and walk in on race morning.

guide.title: Beaches and parks
guide.text: St. Andrews State Park, Shell Island and miles of public beach. Flags, water quality and every access point are on Beaches.

guide.title: Where to eat
guide.text: Every restaurant's latest state inspection, searchable by town.

guide.title: More this week
guide.text: Concerts, markets and festivals from the county, city and visitor bureau calendars.

guide.title: November weather
guide.text: Fall is cooler with lower humidity than summer: good racing weather and a quieter beach.
